title.value: Taiwan Program Kwoh-Ting Li Visiting Fellowship
title.evidence_quote: Taiwan Program Kwoh-Ting Li Visiting Fellowship

institution.name: Walter H. Shorenstein Asia-Pacific Research Center (APARC), Stanford University

qualifications: PhD or a substantial record of professional achievement related to contemporary Taiwan
Visiting from and affiliated with an outside institution or organization
Online form, proposal letter, CV with publications and two letters of reference
description_short: Stanford APARC's Taiwan Program Kwoh-Ting Li Visiting Fellowship hosts a mid-career or senior scholar of contemporary Taiwan for the 2027-2028 academic year, starting autumn quarter 2027. Fellows are expected to secure additional external funding.

deadline.evidence_quote: Applications and all required materials are due March 1, 2027.
